modules.responsibility: bounded transport parsing and stable status mapping
records, policy limits, and legal state transitions
AVI frame access and deterministic visual derivatives
workflow orchestration and commit or fail decisions
namespaced persistence, locks, and atomic commits

entities.label: Video clip
invariants: Stored digest and frame geometry describe the immutable clip bytes
Declared frame count equals the number of parsed frame chunks
A rejected probe leaves no visible clip record

entities.label: Shot inspection
invariants: Scenes are ordered, contiguous, and end at the clip frame count
The first scene starts at frame zero
Failed inspections do not expose successful scenes

entities.label: Contact sheet
invariants: Tile map, dimensions, and artifact digest agree
Each source scene appears at most once
No visible artifact exists before a ready terminal state

state_machines.subject: video_clip
invariants: Only registered clips can be inspected

state_machines.subject: shot_inspection
invariants: only indexed inspections can produce contact sheets
failed records retain a stable code and message

state_machines.subject: contact_sheet
invariants: only ready records resolve an artifact

extension_seams.distinct_outcome: A second container adapter can normalize frame access while preserving clip records and inspection contracts.
Adaptive thresholding can change scene boundaries without changing state or persistence behavior.
Labels and safe-area overlays can be added to cells with a matching tile-map record.
A transactional repository can replace local files without changing HTTP or media contracts.

tension_points.description: Accepting a seemingly readable partial AVI versus proving complete frame and index coverage before publication
tension_points.observable_failure: A truncated payload becomes visible as a clip, or registered geometry disagrees with the stored bytes.

tension_points.description: Splitting on small visual jumps versus preserving a useful minimum scene length and contiguous frame coverage
tension_points.observable_failure: A boundary creates a zero-length scene, overlaps a neighbor, or leaves the final scene short of the clip end.

tension_points.description: Honoring the requested large grid versus enforcing a bounded working set and committing an artifact that exactly matches its tile map
tension_points.observable_failure: An oversized request silently downscales, or a failed composition leaves a fetchable partial PPM.
